context: You are standing inside a tomblike, abandoned chapel at the feet of an unidentified statue, reading a bronze plaque whose inscription is written in an unfamiliar script. The narrator has already stated the text is a mystery, and off-screen the party lacks the means to translate it (no scholar present and no translation magic). The player's line—calling it a "dead language" and suggesting ancient worship—is a speculative inference, not a confirmed fact from the plaque. Companions (for example Shadowheart, if present) are likewise unable to identify the patron deity of the place.
